newsitem.title: INDONESIA: SBC, SBC Warburg open new offices in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: SBC, SBC Warburg open new offices in Indonesia.

text.p: Switzerland's Swiss Bank Corporation (SBC) and global investment bank SBC Warburg said on Wednesday they had launched new offices in Jakarta.

"We are very pleased to be strengthening our presence here with both a representative office and a full service investment bank," Rodney Ward, chairman of SBC Warburg Asia Pacific, said in a statement.
SBC Warburg provides analysts' forecasts and recommendations as well as sector and market commentary.

SBC Warburg has been associated with Indonesia since 1975. The firm was involved in privatisation drives for major Indonesian state-owned companies including satellite firm PT Indosat and telecommunications firm PT Telkom .
The statement did not give further details.
